claims.assertion: Yazhi says that about 40,000 years ago Earth had few large seas, extensive green land, and five additional continents beneath today’s oceans.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: The account describes Atlantis as a planet-wide multiracial civilization and Lemuria as a Lyrian resistance civilization centered on Mu in Oceana.
claims.speaker: Taygetean account, relayed by Robert

claims.assertion: The account interprets Nazca figures and lines as star maps and spacecraft routes, with landing zones and approach data linked to a subterranean control base.
claims.speaker: Taygetean account, relayed by Robert
claims.qualifiers: It says the mapping used base-12 mathematics.

coverage_gaps: Other claims about subterranean species and planetary history omitted
